item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President assigns the Secretary discretionary authority to operate and administer the railroad; this is an internal executive authority assignment, with no specified legal consequence imposed on private parties by this segment itself.","evidence":"The Secretary of Transportation is authorized to operate and administer the Alaska Railroad"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The segment internally allocates and limits the Secretary’s rate-setting authority by making it subject to the Commission’s authority; it does not itself set a rate or dictate a later specified rate outcome.","evidence":"shall be subject to the authority of the Interstate Commerce Commission"},{"segment_id":"3","code":4,"rationale":"This single segment inseparably combines discretionary authority assignments and administrative duties with present legal consequences, including shipper access to filed contracts, preservation of existing rates, and statutory-compliance status.","evidence":"shall have the same force and effect as if it had been entered into in accordance with the provisions of this Order"}]}
